intent.title: Build the Plumb browser issue workspace with diagrams and browser proof
intent.quote: Yes use a workflow to do that. Also integrate the diagrams into the issue explanation if possible. (see diagram-mods ) . Use subagents and workflows to work and spawn review/fix agents and also at the end proove by showing the browser automatically and use subagents to test thoroughly all the buttons, navigation features.
intent.readback: Build the recommended browser issue workspace using selected Escouade presentation components and Plumb's core. Integrate existing diagram-mod diagrams into issue explanations. Use subagents for implementation, review, fixes and thorough interaction tests; show the working browser automatically with evidence.
will: Keep existing Plumb card meanings and exact-content approval checks
Display issue diagrams alongside context, evidence and choices
Test real API outcomes and all exposed browser interactions using isolated data
Show the completed workspace in an installed browser
wont: Replace Plumb's core with Escouade's agent runtime
Approve real owner records during automated demonstration
assumptions: One project at a time remains the scope
A durable next-turn handoff is truthful until live session attachment is available
The installed browser is the demonstration fallback because the in-app execution tool is unavailable

requirements.title: Browser resolves Plumb issues through existing core semantics
requirements.statement: The local browser workspace lists source-session issues, full explanations, evidence and existing actions. Browser answers preserve exact-content approval and offer provenance without changing another surface's credentials, and remain distinct from verified repair completion.

examples.given: An issue and its current record are displayed
examples.when: The owner selects a supported answer
examples.then: Plumb records that action against exactly the displayed content and the browser shows its actual resulting state

examples.given: A displayed record changes before its answer
examples.then: The changed content is not approved and the browser explains the stale answer

examples.given: A Claude mod is already registered
examples.when: The browser opens and resolves an issue
examples.then: The mod registration is preserved and both surfaces retain valid distinct provenance

requirements.title: Issue explanations embed existing diagrams safely
requirements.statement: When an issue references a diagram-mod HTML or SVG artifact inside the project, the browser displays its extracted SVG in the explanation with text alternative and zoom controls. Missing, invalid, oversized or escaping artifacts are reported without disabling issue actions; diagram scripts never execute in the application DOM.

examples.given: A card references generated architecture HTML with toolbar icons
examples.then: The architecture SVG is displayed above its questions with readable labels

examples.given: A diagram is missing or its path escapes the project
examples.then: A clear fallback is shown and the owner's issue choices remain accessible

requirements.title: Browser follow-up reaches the matching agent turn truthfully
requirements.statement: Browser answers queue their follow-up for the source agent session; that session's next prompt hook delivers the context once without treating generated text as a typed owner approval. The browser distinguishes queued and delivered follow-ups and does not claim autonomous execution or successful repair.

examples.given: A browser answer queues a source-session follow-up
examples.then: The message remains queued for its intended session

examples.given: The intended session has a queued follow-up
examples.when: Its next turn hook emits context
examples.then: The follow-up is included once and delivery is shown separately from verification

requirements.title: Browser delivery includes independent interaction proof
requirements.statement: Independent subagents review and test the workspace's exposed buttons and navigation against a real local server with isolated fixtures, findings are fixed, and a browser demonstration plus screenshots and exact test outcomes are provided.

examples.given: The implemented workspace is served with isolated demo records
examples.then: Selections, actions, filters, history, tabs, diagrams, keyboard and narrow layouts are exercised and persisted action results checked
The browser is opened visibly and the user receives its URL, screenshots and measured results
